title: Standard Chartered Hanoi Marathon 2026 Review: IAAF-Certified Old Quarter
meta_description: Standard Chartered Hanoi Marathon Heritage Race 2026 review: November 8, an IAAF/AIMS-certified loop through Hanoi's Old Quarter since 2018.
dek: Set for 8 November 2026, this is the ninth-ish edition of Hanoi's IAAF and AIMS-certified marathon -- debuted in 2018 with 2,600 runners, renamed twice as sponsors changed, and now backed by Standard Chartered.
verdict: The Standard Chartered Hanoi Marathon Heritage Race is the most established, best-documented race in this research batch: it debuted in October 2018 as the Hanoi International Heritage Marathon with over 2,600 runners, was renamed the VPBank Hanoi Marathon in 2019 under new sponsorship, and now runs under Standard Chartered's backing. The course is IAAF and AIMS certified, looping from Ba Kieu Temple to Ly Thai To Park at Hoan Kiem Lake through the historic Old Quarter. Five distances from 2.1K to the full marathon, genuinely affordable pricing (VND 278,000), and multi-year continuity make this one of the most credible picks in the entire research batch.

sections.heading: A Race With Real, Documented History
paragraphs: The race debuted on 21 October 2018 as the Hanoi International Heritage Marathon, attracting more than 2,600 runners in its first year. [1] Since then it has drawn professional and recreational runners, both foreign and Vietnamese, thanks to its course through Hanoi's historic Old Quarter -- one of the few races in this entire research batch with a documented, multi-year public history rather than sparse or absent past-edition data.

sections.heading: Renamed Twice as Sponsorship Changed
paragraphs: In 2019, the race was renamed the VPBank Hanoi Marathon after the Vietnamese private bank became main sponsor; it later came under Standard Chartered's backing, becoming today's Standard Chartered Hanoi Marathon Heritage Race. [1] That sponsor turnover is worth noting for anyone searching historical results -- the same underlying event has operated under at least three different names since 2018.

sections.heading: IAAF and AIMS Certified
paragraphs: The marathon's loop course connects city landmarks, starting at Ba Kieu Temple and finishing at Ly Thai To Park at the central Hoan Kiem Lake -- the same historic lake anchoring the VPBank Hanoi International Marathon covered elsewhere in this research batch, though these are separate events. [1] The race has received certification from the IAAF (now World Athletics) and AIMS (Association of International Marathons and Distance Races) for its course, along with AIMS membership -- a meaningful mark of measurement accuracy and international standards.

sections.heading: Five Distances, Genuinely Affordable
paragraphs: Distances span 2.1K, 5K, 10K, 21.0975K and the full 42.195K, with pricing at VND 278,000 -- a notably accessible price point given the race's international certification and multi-year track record. [1] Registration is currently open via the official race website. [2]

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If you want a genuinely well-established, internationally certified marathon through one of Vietnam's most historic urban cores, Standard Chartered Hanoi Marathon Heritage Race on 8 November 2026 is one of the strongest, most credible picks in this entire research batch. Its documented history since 2018, IAAF/AIMS certification, and affordable pricing set it apart from the many newer or thinner-documented races covered elsewhere.
